spans.s: चुर् vt. 10U (pp. चोरित; pres. चोरयति-ते) 1. To steal, to rob, M.viii.333; (hence) 2. to take, to assume, अचूचुरच्चंद्रमसोऽभिरामताम् Sis.i.16.
चूर्ण् vt. 10U (pp. चूर्णित; pres. चूर्णयति-ते) 1. To reduce to powder, to pulverise; 2. to bruise, to crush.With सम्-, to bruise, to crash, संचूर्णयामि गदया न सुयोधनोरू Ve.i.
चूर्ण (I) m.n. 1. Powder; 2. flour; 3. dust; 4. pounded sandal, camphire &c., भवति विफलप्रेरणा चूर्णमुष्टिः Megh.ii.5.
चूर्ण-कुंतल m. a curl, curly hair.
चूर्णक (I) m. Grain fried and pounded.
चूर्णक (II) n. 1. A fragrant powder; 2. a style of prose composition not abounding in compounds; (अकठोराक्षरं स्वल्पसमासं चूर्णकं विदुः).
चूर्णि f. 1. Pounding, powder; 2. a sum of hundred cowries.
चूर्णि f. 1. Pounding, powder; 2. a sum of hundred cowries.
चूर्णिका f. 1. Grain fried and powdered; 2. a style of prose composition.
चूर्णित a. (f. ता) 1. Pounded; 2. crushed, bruised, shattered, K.S.v.24.
